reason: Attempt 9 reached 75.0%. Development errors still overuse credit reporting for named lending products and checking for money-service disputes. Replace the long category paragraph with compact positive definitions to reduce competing instructions, retaining all ten labels and the same task.
instruction: Assign the most specific financial product supported by the complaint's facts. Mortgage means home-secured borrowing. Student loan means education borrowing. Vehicle loan or lease means car or vehicle purchase financing or leasing. Payday loan, title loan, personal loan, or advance loan means other personal/installment borrowing, payday advances, or loans against an already-owned vehicle title. Credit card means a revolving credit-card account, including its billing, fraud, purchases, rewards, or reporting. Prepaid card means a funded stored-value, gift, reloadable, payroll, or benefit card, including access to the money loaded on it. Checking or savings account means a bank deposit account or its debit-card service. Money transfer, virtual currency, or money service means a disputed remittance, payment transfer, wire, digital wallet, money-service transaction, or cryptocurrency service. Debt collection means a collector's attempts to recover or report a debt. Credit reporting or other personal consumer reports means the consumer-reporting service itself. Reporting errors attached to an identifiable lender's product remain that product; a transfer disputed as a service remains a money-transfer product even if a bank account funded it. Use the main concrete product or service, not incidental vocabulary.
